original_page_visual_review.scope: Entire Chinese source page: prose/proof, all inline/display mathematics,40digit constant, table cells, MIX fields/comments, original exercise difficulty/arrows/parts and polynomial algorithm steps where present.

bilingual_review.scope: Actual English page images inspected alongside Chinese originals, all corresponding prose and formula/sequence/table/program/algorithm fields compared. No fixed page-offset assumption.
bilingual_review.qualification: Original proof transcribed and inspected; recomputation and finite examples are auxiliary and not called general proof.

rendered_proof.qualification: Standalone eight-page proof using current renderer/math CSS; not final whole-volume/site acceptance.

next_steps: Bind into master with page anchors outside formulas/code/tables.
Preserve old page SHA records historically if master binding changes bytes.

tables.rounding_note: Half-way cases such as21/4=5.25 are preserved as original5.3; comparisons use half-unit tolerance, not a global tie-breaking rewrite.
